# FDG3046

> DO prefix descriptive type parameter names with `T`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.1 Names of Generic Type Parameters.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1715
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Single-letter type parameters are left to FDG3044 and FDG3045.

## Options

```ini
dotnet_code_quality.CA1715.exclude_single_letter_type_parameters = true
```
